summary: According to a small computer model rather than human tests, Gemifloxacin Mesylate received a high risk score of 73 for liver issues and a low risk score of 10 for heart issues [M]. A similar drug, Trovafloxacin, carries a boxed warning and was pulled from the market in the United States and two other countries due to liver harm [3]. Other similar medications, Moxifloxacin and Ciprofloxacin, both carry boxed warnings in the United States for muscle and bone problems, nerve and brain harm, and heart harm in the case of Moxifloxacin [4][5].
